caption: Original instrumental chamber-folk reading music in G major pentatonic, 76 BPM, spacious 4/4. The same river-journey theme palette: mellow guqin plucks, breathy low xiao, warm soft cello, a quiet sheng cushion, very sparse gentle wood taps. Develop a tender ascending question and a gently descending answer across two and a half minutes, with long open measures between phrases, a quieter middle passage where only guqin and cello remain, then a small flute return, ending in a soft open-fifth tail that can rejoin the beginning. A small wooden boat moves slowly from a misty home river toward distant mountains, quiet courage and homesickness, warm human acoustic detail, no dramatic swell, no busy melody, no drums groove, no vocals, no choir, no speech, no electronic instruments or trailer impacts. Consistently quiet supportive dynamics and restrained natural room reverb.

caption: Pure instrumental winter chamber ambient reading score, 60 BPM, A minor pentatonic, loose 4/4, two and a half minutes of fragile unfinished conversation beside dying embers. One LOW breathy xiao bamboo flute with air in its tone, extremely sparse guqin single notes, softly bowed close cello harmonic and the faintest distant sheng breath. A three-note question pauses before its last note; repeat it with tiny rhythmic differences and long empty bars. The middle recedes to cello and silence, then one very small flute reply returns. Thin texture throughout, long spaces to read, no melodic runs, no bright upper flute, no percussion, no rhythm track, no crescendo, no orchestra, no vocals, no humming, no choir, no spoken words, no electronic pads. Natural quiet room sound, muted soft transients. A dignified restrained ending, no final emphatic chord, open and gently loopable. Keep the mood human and warm close to the listener despite the cold distance.

caption: Original instrumental literary visual novel score, D major pentatonic, 68 BPM, spacious 4/4, two and a half minutes. A wide quiet river lit from below by stars, the tenderness of sitting down beside people whose names are remembered. Gentle guqin arpeggio fragments, low lyrical cello, felt piano with soft felt attack, breathy xiao answers and a very quiet sheng sustaining open fifths. Begin with a small five-note ascending phrase and leave a full bar to breathe; develop a restrained softer answering phrase, let the middle thin to piano and guqin, then return the flute without growing louder. An intimate acoustic ensemble and natural room depth, soft detailed transient texture, poised warm clarity rather than a huge glittering fantasy orchestra. Reading music with long rests, no dramatic climax, no busy high melody, no percussion groove, no bell repetition, no vocals, no choir, no speech, no electronic lead. Gentle unresolved open-fifth ending suitable for an unobtrusive loop. Calm consolation and continuing life, no sentimental swell.
